title: Provexar — Practical AI products
excerpt: Practical AI products for private knowledge, expert work, and learning.
content_html:
Sanitizer

Convert · Sanitize · Index— before anything reaches an LLM

AI assistants are at their best when they can read your project documents — and at their most dangerous when those documents carry things they were never meant to see. Sanitizer prepares document packages that are safe, light, and built for how AI actually reads.

Read the privacy policy

Choose your edition

Local by design. Licensed for how you use it.

Business & commercial

Sanitizer (Business)

Prepare company documents for AI without exposing client identities, credentials, or other sensitive data. Turn large project files into a clean, searchable knowledge base so teams get faster, more precise answers with less noise.

Free for personal use

Sanitizer (Personal)

Use AI with your personal documents while keeping private details under your control. Sanitizer cleans, converts, and organizes files locally so your AI assistant can find the right information without reading everything.

SHA-256 (verify your download matches)

8C6300B284D1BB489FB49DE97D964AB33F3CD29BCE5DB6357BCF2C9DBD0007CF

Check it in PowerShell:Get-FileHash .\SanitizerSetup.exe -Algorithm SHA256

A note on the Personal installer:it isn't code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may show "Windows protected your PC." That's expected for a free direct download — click More info → Run anyway. Verifying the SHA-256 above confirms the file is exactly the one we published. The Microsoft Store edition is signed by Microsoft and installs without any warning.

01

Nothing sensitive ever reaches an AI

Every document is scrubbed on this computer, beforeany AI is involved: names, contacts, client identities, credentials, keys — removed or replaced with opaque tokens per your project policy. Originals and the un-redact vault stay in Sanitizer's private storage; the AI-ready workspace contains sanitized material only. In reversible mode, answers can be un-redacted locally — so the AI works blind, but you don't.

02

Heavy formats in, lightweight files out

A 40 MB PDF or Word file is mostly baggage: layout data, embedded fonts, metadata, binary bloat. Sanitizer converts everything to clean Markdown and flat CSV — the same content at a fraction of the size. Your AI spends its tokens and its context window on the actual engineering text, not on format garbage, which makes answers cheaper and sharper.

03

A searchable database, not a pile of files

Every document is chunked and indexed twice — a full-text index for exact terms, tags and standards references, and a semantic index that finds passages by meaning. AI agents get purpose-built retrieval tools automatically, so they pull the five relevant paragraphs instead of swallowing five hundred pages, and cite the page they came from.

Everything — conversion, OCR, sanitation, indexing, search — runs locally. No cloud services, no uploads, no accounts. The only thing an AI ever sees is what's left after Sanitizer is done.

03

You may not sell, rent, sublicense, or redistribute the installer or the software; remove or alter its notices; or reverse-engineer it except to the extent that right cannot be waived under applicable law. You may make copies only as needed for your own personal use and backup.

04

Local operation and your data

Sanitizer runs on your computer and processes your documents locally. You are responsible for the documents you process and for reviewing sanitized output before sharing it. See our privacy policy.

05

The software is provided "as is," without warranty of any kind, express or implied, including merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose, and non-infringement. You use it at your own risk.

06

Sanitizer includes open-source components under their own licenses, listed in the THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES file included with the app.

Termination

This license ends automatically if you breach its terms; on termination you must stop using and remove the software.

输入重格式，输出轻文件

40 MB 的 PDF 或 Word 文件主要是行李：布局数据、嵌入字体、元数据、二进制膨胀。 Sanitizer 将所有内容转换为干净的 Markdown 和平面 CSV — 内容相同，大小却只有一小部分。 你的人工智能将其标记和上下文窗口花费在实际的工程文本上，而不是格式垃圾上，这使得答案更便宜、更清晰。

03

一个可搜索的数据库，而不是一堆文件

每个文档都会被分块并索引两次——一个是精确术语、标签和标准参考的全文索引，另一个是按含义查找段落的语义索引。 人工智能代理会自动获得专门构建的检索工具，因此他们会提取五个相关段落，而不是吞下五百页，并引用它们来自的页面。

一切——转换、OCR、卫生、索引、搜索——都在本地运行。 没有云服务，没有上传，没有帐户。 人工智能唯一能看到的就是消毒剂完成后剩下的东西。
